span.p: CI backend (1/2) : matrice catalog-service et notification-service, chaque job attend le précédent (needs)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
push, toutes branches
pull_request vers main

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1. lint
ruff check, ruff format --check,
mypy --strict src
BLOQUE si erreur

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. test
pytest, testcontainers
PostgreSQL et RabbitMQ
--cov-fail-under=80
BLOQUE si test KO ou couverture < 80 %
artefacts : coverage.xml, JUnit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. sonar
SonarCloud, un projet par service
(sonar.projectKey distinct)
sonar.qualitygate.wait=true
BLOQUE si quality gate KO

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. build-scan (matrice)
image amd64 non-root
trivy image --scanners vuln,secret
--severity CRITICAL,HIGH
--ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1
BLOQUE si CRITICAL ou HIGH corrigeable
ou secret CRITICAL ou HIGH
artefact : image tar
(docker save, upload-artifact)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5. acceptance (une fois)
needs : build-scan des 2 services
download-artifact, docker load,
docker compose up : PostgreSQL,
RabbitMQ, Keycloak, 2 services
attente /health/ready
pytest tests/acceptance
BLOQUE si un critère échoue
artefact : JUnit

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6. publish
if: github.ref ==
refs/heads/main
et jobs précédents verts ?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GHCR : ghcr.io/luucaaas/service
tags sha-xxxxxxx et main
amd64 + arm64
seul le digest est immuable
